reviewFlags.issue: Samsung Israel's official page lists this unit as RT42CG6004WWML (suffix ML). The exact model RT42CG6004WW appears only on Israeli retailer pages, and the ML page was not used as evidence. Confirm the Israeli variant before publishing.

Retailers conflict. BetterShop gives 420 L gross with 323 L fridge and 97 L freezer; CityDeal gives 415 L net. The catalog's 317 L fridge and 98 L freezer match CityDeal's net split, which could not be quoted on one line.
Catalog depth is 67.2 cm, but both retailers give 67.5 cm. Check door-to-wall depth before a niche install.

Warranty terms conflict. BetterShop's copy claims a 10-year compressor warranty, while its warranty line and CityDeal give 1 year from the importer plus 3 years of service for 99 ₪. Verify the official terms with the importer.
No retailer page for this exact model gives a weight, so the catalog's 59 kg is unverified. Samsung's ML-variant page lists 58.5 kg net, but it is not used as evidence.
The catalog's daily figure of 0.66 kWh is unverified. Retailer pages give the annual figure as 243 kWh, not 241 kWh.
Samsung Israel lists the unit as RT42CG6004WWML; confirm the Israeli suffix of the catalog SKU.
Catalog lists 317/98 L (likely net split); published values are the gross split 323/97 L. Check catalog wording.
Catalog depth 67.2 cm vs 67.5 cm on both retailer pages.
Catalog says about 241 kWh/year; retailer gives 243 kWh/year. Daily 0.66 kWh unverified.
Warranty terms conflict between retailer copy; verify official terms with the importer.
Catalog weight 59 kg not verified by any source.

qa.notes: Rejected warranty fact (retailer copy conflicts on warranty terms and the value includes a price). Trimmed All Around Cooling feature wording to what the quote supports. Fridge/freezer split 323/97 L is the gross split from BetterShop; catalog 317/98 L appears to be the net split and is not published.
